claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Fexofenadine is a peripherally restricted, non-cytotoxic antihistamine that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any apparent activity would reflect weak, non-specific effects rather than a defined cytotoxic mechanism.
